value.name: Fiamma Mission
value.tagline: Wood-fired pizza and Ligurian seafood on Valencia Street.
value.about: Our first restaurant, opened in 2016 around a 4-ton oven built by hand in Naples. Chef Giulia Ferraro cooks almost everything over oak.
value.accessibility: Step-free entrance on Valencia St, accessible restroom at the back of the dining room, high chairs on request.
value.parking: Street parking is tight after 6pm. 16th St BART is a 6-minute walk; bike racks out front.
value.walkInNote: The bar and the counter by the oven are always kept for walk-ins.
